views.name: Step 1
views.caption: Remove all 64 LED Stems from D8, D7, and D6.
views.caution: Disconnect the USB Cable from the computer or power supply before you begin.

views.name: Step 1c
views.caption: Remove all 64 LED Stems from D8, D7, and D6.
views.caution: Disconnect the USB Cable from the computer or power supply before you begin.

views.name: Step 2

inset.alt: Close-up of D8 under the latch at the top of a D11 post
inset.caption: The latch on each D11 post

views.caption: Remove D8 from the latches of the four D11 posts.

views.name: Step 2c
views.caption: Remove D8 from the latches of the four D11 posts.

views.name: Step 3

inset.alt: Close-up of D7 in the notch of a D11 post
inset.caption: D7 in the notch of each D11 post

views.caption: Remove D7 from the four D11 posts.

views.name: Step 3c
views.caption: Remove D7 from the four D11 posts.

views.name: Step 4

inset.alt: Close-up of the corner of D5 and D2: red boxes around the ends of D2's two tabs, which pass through D5
inset.caption: D2's tabs through D5

views.caption: Remove D5 from the tabs of D1, D2, and D3.

views.name: Step 4c
views.caption: Remove D5 from the tabs of D1, D2, and D3.

views.name: Step 5

inset.alt: Close-up of the corner of D4 and D2: red boxes around the ends of D2's two tabs, which pass through D4
inset.caption: D2's tabs through D4

views.caption: Slide D4 off the tabs of D1, D2, and D3, along the USB Cable. Then, lift it up off the cable.

views.name: Step 5c
views.caption: Slide D4 off the tabs of D1, D2, and D3, along the USB Cable. Then, lift it up off the cable.

views.name: Step 6

inset.alt: Close-up from below of a D11 tab through its slot in D1
inset.caption: The tab through D1

views.caption: Lift the box and push the tabs of the two D11 posts nearest the USB Cable up out of the slots in D1 from underneath. Then, push each tab up through its corner slot in D6, and remove the posts.
views.caution: Squeeze the two prongs of each tab together to free its barb, under D1 and again under D6.

views.name: Step 6c
views.caption: Lift the box and push the tabs of the two D11 posts nearest the USB Cable up out of the slots in D1 from underneath. Then, push each tab up through its corner slot in D6, and remove the posts.
views.caution: Squeeze the two prongs of each tab together to free its barb, under D1 and again under D6.

views.name: Step 7

inset.alt: Close-up from below of a D11 tab through its slot in D1
inset.caption: The tab through D1

views.caption: Push the tabs of the other two D11 posts up out of D1 and through D6 the same way, and remove the posts.
views.caution: Squeeze the two prongs of each tab together to free its barb, under D1 and again under D6.

views.name: Step 7c
views.caption: Push the tabs of the other two D11 posts up out of D1 and through D6 the same way, and remove the posts.
views.caution: Squeeze the two prongs of each tab together to free its barb, under D1 and again under D6.

views.name: Step 8
views.caption: Remove D6 from the tabs of D2 and D3.

views.name: Step 8c
views.caption: Remove D6 from the tabs of D2 and D3.

views.name: Step 9
views.caption: Lift the LED Matrix, with D10 hooked under it, up off the two D9 pieces. Leave its wires connected.

views.name: Step 9c
views.caption: Lift the LED Matrix, with D10 hooked under it, up off the two D9 pieces. Leave its wires connected.

views.name: Step 10
views.caption: Slide D10 along the bottom of the LED Matrix, away from its pins, until its hooks come free of the edges. Then, remove it.

views.name: Step 10c
views.caption: Slide D10 along the bottom of the LED Matrix, away from its pins, until its hooks come free of the edges. Then, remove it.

views.name: Step 11
views.caption: Disconnect the three breadboard wires from the V+, IN, and V- pins on the LED Matrix, and remove the LED Matrix. Leave the wires in the breadboard.
views.caution: Hold the three black connectors while you pull the LED Matrix's pins out of them. Do not pull on the wires themselves.

views.name: Step 11c
views.caption: Disconnect the three breadboard wires from the V+, IN, and V- pins on the LED Matrix, and remove the LED Matrix. Leave the wires in the breadboard.
views.caution: Hold the three black connectors while you pull the LED Matrix's pins out of them. Do not pull on the wires themselves.

views.name: Step 12
views.caption: Lay the three breadboard wires out of the box, over the open end where D4 was. Leave them in the breadboard.

views.name: Step 12c
views.caption: Lay the three breadboard wires out of the box, over the open end where D4 was. Leave them in the breadboard.

views.name: Step 13
views.caption: Remove both D9 pieces from the slots in D2 and D3.

views.name: Step 13c
views.caption: Remove both D9 pieces from the slots in D2 and D3.

views.name: Step 14
views.caption: Disconnect the yellow, gray, and purple breadboard wires from i2, i3, and b19.
views.caution: Pull each wire out by its connector. Do not pull on the wires themselves.

views.name: Step 14c
views.caption: Disconnect the yellow, gray, and purple breadboard wires from i2, i3, and b19.
views.caution: Pull each wire out by its connector. Do not pull on the wires themselves.

views.name: Step 15

inset.alt: Close-up of the latch on D1 that holds the foot of D3
inset.caption: The latch on D1 at the foot of D3

views.caption: Remove D3 from the latch on D1.

views.name: Step 15c
views.caption: Remove D3 from the latch on D1.

views.name: Step 16

inset.alt: Close-up of the latch on D1 that holds the foot of D2
inset.caption: The latch on D1 at the foot of D2

views.caption: Slide D2, with the Push Button, off the latch on D1 and out of its slots. Leave the Push Button's wires connected.

views.name: Step 16c
views.caption: Slide D2, with the Push Button, off the latch on D1 and out of its slots. Leave the Push Button's wires connected.

views.name: Step 17
views.caption: Disconnect the Push Button's red wire from j5 and its black wire from j16.
views.caution: Pull each wire out by its connector. Do not pull on the wires themselves.

views.name: Step 17c
views.caption: Disconnect the Push Button's red wire from j5 and its black wire from j16.
views.caution: Pull each wire out by its connector. Do not pull on the wires themselves.

views.name: Step 18
views.caption: Unscrew the nut from the Push Button, on the inside of D2, and slide it off over the wires.

views.name: Step 18c
views.caption: Unscrew the nut from the Push Button, on the inside of D2, and slide it off over the wires.

views.name: Step 19
views.caption: Remove the Push Button from D2, pulling its wires back through the hole.

views.name: Step 19c
views.caption: Remove the Push Button from D2, pulling its wires back through the hole.

views.name: Step 20
views.caption: Slide the nut back over the Push Button's wires and screw it onto the Push Button, so that the two stay together.

views.name: Step 20c
views.caption: Slide the nut back over the Push Button's wires and screw it onto the Push Button, so that the two stay together.

views.name: Step 21
views.caption: Disconnect the USB Cable from the Nano Board.

views.name: Step 21c
views.caption: Disconnect the USB Cable from the Nano Board.

views.name: Step 22
views.caption: Remove the 330 Ω Resistor from a11 and a19.

views.name: Step 22c
views.caption: Remove the 330 Ω Resistor from a11 and a19.

views.name: Step 23
views.caption: Remove the Capacitor from j2 and j3.

views.name: Step 23c
views.caption: Remove the Capacitor from j2 and j3.

views.name: Step 24
views.caption: Remove the 12 kΩ Resistor from h3 and h16.

views.name: Step 24c
views.caption: Remove the 12 kΩ Resistor from h3 and h16.

views.name: Step 25
views.caption: Remove the Nano Board from the Breadboard.
views.caution: Use the Pry Tool to carefully remove the Nano Board.

views.name: Step 25c
views.caption: Remove the Nano Board from the Breadboard.
views.caution: Use the Pry Tool to carefully remove the Nano Board.
